blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 现有空间推理基准主要测试空间感知:读取输入中已经可见的关系. 然而,现实世界的空间智能需要预测空间推理:从观测中构建一个场景,预测干预如何改变它,以及对看不见的结果进行推理. 我们介绍了SpaceCast-Bench,这是直接和诊断性地评估这种能力的第一个基准。 围绕一个观测-变形法框架,182个真实世界场景的3862个问题涉及16个任务类型,分三个层面:静态感知、局部预测和全球预测,逐步需要场景理解、空间状态更新以及对未观测结果的关联推论。 评估21种模型暴露出一个明显的差距:最强模型只达到58.0%,而人类的性能为87.2%,而空间专用模型仍然接近随机机会. 受控制的分析进一步表明,桥梁观点对综合分布式观测至关重要,明确的立体证据模型比生成的结果图像或视频更可靠。 微调我们方案生成的数据,将Qune3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%,在六个领域外基准中实现宏观平均收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual-spatial intelligence entails perceiving and mentally manipulating spatial relationships, encompassing relational reasoning and the ability to transform between egocentric and allocentric perspectives ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Gardner, 2011 ) . This capacity is fundamental for vision-language models to understand and act in the physical world. Recent benchmarks spanning single-image relation grounding ( Kamath et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ) , 3D metric estimation ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) , and multi-view integration ( Li et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2025a ) have driven rapid progress in spatial perception ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉-空间智能包括感知和精神操纵空间关系,包括关系推理和自我中心观点和对等中心观点之间的转变能力(Yang等,2025a;Gardner,2011)。 这种能力对于视觉语言模型在物理世界中理解和行动至关重要. 涵盖单一图像关系基础的近期基准(Kamath等,2023年;Du等,2024年),3D计量估计(Ma等,2025年;Cheng等,2024年),以及多视角融合(Li等,2025年;Yang等,2026年a; Yang等人,2025a.)推动了空间感知的迅速进步(Oyang等人,2025;Wu等人,2025;Li等人,2026.).

blocks.en: Yet these benchmarks share a fundamental limitation: they evaluate spatial perception , the ability to read off relations already present in the observed frames ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . What they overlook is spatial prediction , the ability to anticipate how a scene will be reconfigured after an intervention. Consider a robot retrieving an envelope beneath a book with a cup resting on top: to plan safely, it must predict that sliding the book will displace the cup and decide to move the cup first. This requires constructing a mental model of the scene, simulating the consequences of an action, and revising the plan accordingly. Such predictive spatial reasoning is a prerequisite for safe manipulation and multi-step planning, and precisely what spatial world models must learn ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) : represent an environment in a form that supports anticipating action consequences even when those consequences are never shown. Despite its centrality to embodied intelligence, no existing benchmark evaluates this capability in a controlled and diagnostically decomposable way.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些基准有一个根本的局限性:它们评价空间感知、读取观测到的框架(Tong等,2024;Cheng等,2024;Zhang等,2025a;Yang等,2025a)中已经存在的关系的能力。 他们忽略的是空间预测, 预测一个场景如何在干预后重组的能力。 想想一个机器人在书下取回一个信封,上面放着一个杯子:为了安全地计划,它必须预测滑动的书会取代杯子,决定先移动杯子. 这需要构建一个场景的心理模型,模拟一个行动的后果,并相应修改计划. 这种预测性的空间推理是安全操纵和多步骤规划的先决条件,并且正是空间世界模型必须学会的(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018;Hafner等人, 2019;Hafner等人, 2025;Assran等人, 2025) : 代表一种支持预测行动后果的环境,即使这些后果从未显示出来. 尽管这种能力对体现情报具有核心作用,但没有任何现有基准以可控制和可诊断的可分解方式评估这种能力。

blocks.en: To fill this gap, we introduce SpaceCast-Bench , the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate predictive spatial reasoning, comprising 3,862 questions from 182 scenes across 16 task types (Figure 1 ). Built around an observe–transform–infer framework, the benchmark progressively evaluates scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. To instantiate this at scale, we develop a geometry-grounded pipeline that builds question-conditioned, depth-verified view chains from posed RGB-D scans, applies controlled local or global transformations in 3D, and derives programmatic labels while keeping the resulting state unobserved. Tasks span three capability levels: L1 (Static Perception) , probing spatial relations in an unmodified scene from single- or multi-view observations; L2 (Local Prediction) , testing anticipation of relation changes after localized object-level interventions; and L3 (Global Prediction) , testing reasoning after a rigid transformation is applied to the entire layout. Across the benchmark, tasks cover direction, distance, visibility and occlusion, and attachment structure, with directional relations posed in camera-centric, object-centric, and world-centric reference frames, enabling granular diagnosis of where model reasoning breaks down.
blocks.zh: 为了填补这一空白,我们引入了SpaceCast-Bench,这是直接和诊断性地评估预测空间推理的第一个基准,由来自182个场景的3,862个问题组成,涵盖16个任务类型(图一)。 基准以观察-变换-推算框架为基础,逐步评估场景理解、空间状态更新和对未观测结果的关系推论。 为了在规模上即兴发挥这种作用,我们开发了一个几何地基管道,从所立的RGB-D扫描中构建出有问题、深度验证的取景链,在3D中应用受控的局部或全球变换,并获得程序标签,同时使由此产生的状态不被观察。 任务跨越三个能力级别:L1(Static Perseption),从单景或多景观测中检测未修改场景中的空间关系;L2(局部预测),在局部对象级干预后测试对关系变化的预测;和L3(全球预测),测试刚性变换后的推理应用于整个布局. 在整个基准中,任务包括方向、距离、能见度和隐蔽性以及附件结构,其方向关系以相机为中心、以物体为中心以及以世界为中心的基准框架构成,从而能够对模型推理破裂之处进行颗粒性诊断。

blocks.en: Experiments across 21 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized models reveal a substantial gap: the strongest model achieves only 58.0% accuracy against human performance of 87.2%, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance, indicating that existing spatial training does not transfer to spatial state updating. Controlled analyses show that CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) prompting provides no consistent benefit, bridge views aid integration of distributed observations, and explicit 3D evidence benefits strong general-purpose models far more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Finally, post-training experiments show that benchmark-aligned training substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B: staged SFT raises overall accuracy from 34.0% to 65.7% on SpaceCast-Bench and yields consistent gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks, confirming that our pipeline supports both systematic diagnosis and transferable model improvement.
blocks.zh: 跨出21个专有,开放重量,空间专用模型的实验揭示出巨大的差距:最强模型相对于87.2%的人类性能只有58.0%的精度,而空间专用模型仍然近乎随机的机会,表明现有的空间训练并没有转移到空间状态更新. 受控分析显示,CoT(Wei等,2022年)促动不能提供一致的好处,桥接视图有助于集成分布式观测结果,明确的立体证据比生成的结果图像或视频更可靠地有利于强大的通用模型。 最后,培训后实验显示,与基准一致的培训大大改善了Qune3-VL-4B:在SpaceCast-Bench上,SFT将总体精度从34.0%提高到65.7%,并在六个领域外的基准中取得一致的收益,这证实了我们的管道支持系统诊断和可转移模型改进。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: (i) We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark for diagnostic evaluation of predictive spatial reasoning, with 3,862 questions from 182 scenes across 16 task types. (ii) We develop a geometry-grounded pipeline that builds depth-verified view chains, applies controlled 3D transformations, and programmatically derives labels for unobserved outcome states. (iii) We evaluate 21 models with controlled analyses revealing a substantial human–model gap and distinct bottlenecks across model families, and show that training on our generated data improves both in-domain and six out-of-domain benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: (一)我们介绍SpaceCast-Bench,这是预测空间推理诊断评价的第一个基准,共有182个场景的3862个问题,共16个任务类型. (二)我们开发出一条几何地基管来构建深度验证的取景链,应用受控三维变换,在程序上为未观测到的结果状态取出标签. (三) 我们评价21个模型,进行有控制的分析,发现模型家庭存在巨大的人模型差距和明显的瓶颈,并表明关于我们生成的数据的培训既改善了域内基准,也改善了六个域外基准。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Benchmarks for Perceptive Spatial Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.1 感知空间理由基准

blocks.en: Early spatial benchmarks evaluate relations in a single observed image. What’sUp ( Kamath et al., 2023 ) and EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) focus on basic directional and embodied spatial questions, while SpatialRGPT-Bench ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) and 3DSRBench ( Ma et al., 2025 ) broaden the relation set using 3D annotations and natural scenes. Multi-image and video benchmarks extend this to sequential or multi-view inputs: SPAR-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) covers depth, distance, cross-view matching, and spatial relations, ViewSpatial-Bench ( Li et al., 2025 ) evaluates spatial localization from multiple perspectives, MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) provides a human-curated evaluation spanning positional relationships, attributes, and multi-step reasoning, and VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025a ) evaluates spatial configurations and metric estimation from egocentric video. All these benchmarks center on spatial perception of existing scenes, without requiring any reasoning about how relations change after an intervention.
blocks.zh: 早期的空间基准以单一被观测到的图像评价关系. What's Up (Kamath等, 2023年)和EmbSpatial-Bench (Du等, 2024年) 专注于基本的方向和包含的空间问题,而SpaceRGPT-Bench(Cheng等, 2024年)和3DSR Bench(Ma等, 2025年)则使用3D说明和自然场景来拓宽关系集. 多图像和视频基准将此扩展到相继或多视图输入: SPAR-Bench(Zhang等,2025年a)涵盖深度,距离,跨视比对,和空间关系,ViewSpatial-Bench(Li等,2025年)从多角度评价空间局部化,MMSI-Bench(Yang等,2026年a)提供由人验证的跨越位置关系,属性,多步推理的评价,VSI-Bench(Yang等,2025年a年)从自负心视频中评价空间配置和度量估计. 所有这些基准都以现有场景的空间感知为中心,而不需要任何关于关系在干预后如何变化的推理.

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarks for Predictive Spatial Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.2 预测空间理由的基准

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks have begun to evaluate reasoning over scene change. CLEVRER ( Yi et al., 2020 ) evaluates physical events and counterfactuals in synthetic collision videos, and SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) combines observed motion with hypothetical ego actions, with both grounded in observed evidence. MindCube ( Wang et al., 2026 ) studies what-if object motion from limited views, SpaMEM ( Liao et al., 2026 ) tests belief revision after object operations, and SpatialWorld ( Gao et al., 2026 ) evaluates agents that gather evidence and act in a closed loop. While these works touch on aspects of predictive reasoning, SpaceCast-Bench is the first comprehensive benchmark to directly evaluate predictive spatial reasoning under controlled scene transformations.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准已经开始评价场景变化的推理。 CLEVRER(Yi等,2020年)评价了合成相撞视频中的物理事件和反事实,而SAT(Ray等,2025年)则将被观测到的运动与假设的自负行为相结合,两者都基于被观测到的证据. MindCube (Wang等,2026年)从有限角度研究物体运动,SpaMEM (Liao等,2026年)在物体操作后测试信念修正,SpaceWorld(Gao等,2026年)评价收集出证据并在闭环中行动的特工. 虽然这些作品触及了预测推理的各个方面,但SpaceCast-Bench是第一个在受控场地变下直接评价预测空间推理的全面基准.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: SpaceCast-Bench evaluates whether a vision-language model can anticipate how spatial relations change after an intervention it never observes. The initial scene state S 0 S_{0} is observed through an ordered sequence of RGB views 𝒪 = ( I 1 , … , I m ) \mathcal{O}=(I_{1},\ldots,I_{m}) sampled exclusively from the pre-transformation scene. Given 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , a natural-language transformation T T , and a spatial query q q , the model must evaluate q q in the unobserved result state S 1 = F ⁡ ( S 0 , T ) S_{1}=F(S_{0},T) . This requires three latent operations: integrating 𝒪 \mathcal{O} to recover the relevant portion of S 0 S_{0} , applying T T to obtain S 1 S_{1} , and evaluating q q in S 1 S_{1} . This observe–transform–infer pipeline distinguishes predictive spatial reasoning from the perceptual task of reading off relations already visible in the input.

blocks.en: As illustrated by the representative task instances in Figure 3 , we organize tasks into three capability levels of increasing demand. L1 (Static Perception) sets T T to the identity, so S 1 = S 0 S_{1}=S_{0} and the queried relation is directly recoverable from 𝒪 \mathcal{O} . These tasks probe spatial perception across direction, distance, visibility and occlusion, and attachment structure from single- or multi-view observations, establishing a perceptual baseline and isolating failures in the observe stage from those in the transform–infer stages. L2 (Local Prediction) applies a localized intervention to a single object, translating, orbiting, or removing it together with its attachment dependents, while leaving the rest of the scene intact. These tasks test whether the model can simulate an object-level action and evaluate the queried relation in the unobserved S 1 S_{1} without corrupting its representation of unaffected regions. L3 (Global Prediction) applies a rigid yaw rotation to the complete layout, requiring a scene representation explicitly decoupled from the observed camera perspective and robust to conflation of scene rotation with a viewpoint change.

blocks.en: Across the benchmark, queried relations span direction, distance, visibility, occlusion, and attachment structure, with directional relations expressed in camera-centric, object-centric, and world-centric frames. This factorization across capability level, relation type, and reference frame enables targeted diagnosis of where model reasoning breaks down.
blocks.zh: 在整个基准中,对关系提出疑问,涉及方向、距离、能见度、隔离和附件结构,其方向关系以相机、物体和以世界为中心的框架表示。 这种跨能力层次、关系类型和参考框架的因子化使得能够有针对性地诊断模型推理的分解之处。

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准建设

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes our four-stage benchmark construction pipeline, built from 134 ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and 48 ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) scenes. Each scene provides RGB images with calibrated camera poses, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, and instance-level semantic annotations; we derive each instance’s surface geometry, 3D center, and axis-aligned bounding box from its mesh. We additionally construct a directed attachment graph where a parent-to-child edge indicates that displacing the parent also displaces the child; edges are proposed from surface contact, support overlap, and semantic compatibility, with each child assigned at most one parent. The transitive closure of this graph determines co-movement under local interventions and is used to generate attachment-chain questions. For each task type, we enumerate candidate object tuples and select a view chain grounded in their spatial arrangement.
blocks.zh: 图2概述了我们从134个ScanNet(Dai等人,2017年)和48个ScanNet++建造的四级基准建设管道 (Yishwanth等, 2023) (中文(简体) ). 每个场景都提供 RGB 图像, 带有校正相机的外观, 深度地图, 重建了 3D 几何, 以及实例级的语义说明; 我们从它的网格中得出了每个实例的地表几何, 3D 中心, 和轴相接的边框 。 我们另外构建一个直接的附图,其中父母对子女的边缘表明,将父母取代也会取代子女;边缘是从表面接触、支持重叠和语义相容的基础上提出的,每个子女最多分配在父母一方。 本图的过渡性关闭决定了当地干预下的共同移动,并被用来产生附件链问题. 对于每个任务类型,我们列出候选对象Tuple,并选择基于其空间安排的取景链.

blocks.en: Cross-view questions require two anchor views such that each anchor exposes its assigned query-object group while excluding the other. Candidate anchors are filtered by camera validity, image quality, projected object area, and geometric visibility, then selected to satisfy mutual semantic disjointness: neither anchor reveals the objects assigned to the other. Bridge views connect the two anchors via a depth-verified corridor between the aggregate centers of the two object groups; each consecutive pair must overlap the corridor by at least 10% and advance toward the opposite anchor, and no bridge view may re-expose both groups. The resulting view chain is ordered along the selected traversal and contains only pre-transformation observations. Three task types require a single anchor; the remaining 13 use the disjoint-anchor construction.
blocks.zh: 交叉视图问题需要两个主锚视图,这样每个主锚就会暴露其指定的查询-对象组而排除另一个. 候选锚被通过相机有效性,图像质量,投影对象区域,和几何能见度进行过滤,然后被选中来满足相互语义上的不相通性:两个锚都不显示指定给对方的对象. 桥梁视角通过两个物体群的集合中心之间的深度验证通道连接两个锚地;每对相接者必须至少与走廊相重叠10%并推进到相反的锚地,任何桥地视角都不得再次接触两个组地. 由此形成的取景链被沿着所选的曲面顺序排列,并仅包含前变形观测. 3个任务类型需要单一锚;其余13个使用脱节-锚地构造.

blocks.en: Given the object tuple and view chain, we compute relation labels directly from 3D geometry according to the task type. Direction projects object centers onto the floor plane and resolves their relative vector into eight horizontal sectors plus above and below; camera-centric, object-centric, and world-centric variants express this vector in the designated coordinate frame. Distance approximates the shortest surface-to-surface separation using sampled mesh points and maps it to four categorical bins of increasing distance. Visibility and occlusion use mesh ray casting from the calibrated camera center, with aggregated outcomes distinguishing not occluded, occluded, and not visible. Attachment queries the transitive closure of the attachment graph, requiring exact-set identification of all objects displaced when a root is moved. For predictive questions, we apply the specified transformation to the relevant object geometry, translating, orbiting, or removing an object or rotating the complete layout, and rerun the engine on the resulting state to obtain the ground-truth label. Geometrically ambiguous cases, labels near decision boundaries, and invalid motion endpoints are excluded across all relation families.
blocks.zh: 考虑到对象的tuple和视图链,我们根据任务类型直接从3D几何计算关系标签. 引导项目对象中心位于平面上,并解决其相对向量进入上下八个水平区;以相机为中心,以物体为中心,以世界为中心变体在指定的坐标框中表达出这个向量. 距离大约是利用取样的网点进行最短的地对地分离,并将其映射到四个直截了当的距离增大的盒子上。 可见度和隐蔽度使用从被校正相机中心取出网状射线铸造,总合结果区分出不被被被被被遮住,被被遮住,并且不可见. 附件查询附件图的过渡性关闭, 需要精确地确定在移动根时移动的所有对象 。 对于预测性的问题,我们将指定的变换应用到相关的物体几何,翻译,轨道,或去除一个物体,或旋转完整的布局,并重新运行所形成的状态上的引擎来得到地-真标记. 在所有关系家族中,都排除了几何模糊的情况、接近决定界限的标签和无效的运动终点。

blocks.en: We combine automatic filtering with human verification to ensure geometric validity and question clarity. Automatic filtering removes geometrically ambiguous relations, labels near decision boundaries, invalid motion endpoints, insufficient visual grounding, and near-duplicates defined by scene, view, task type, and object identity. Answer positions are balanced within the generated pool before the benchmark is frozen. Human verification was conducted by 10 annotators, with every question receiving at least two independent reviews based on the model-visible input; reviewers checked object identifiability, visual answerability, and question clarity, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer. Before adjudication, single-answer questions achieved 98.9% pairwise agreement and attachment-chain questions achieved 91.8% exact-set agreement. See Appendix B for complete task definitions, construction details, and quality-control procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们把自动过滤与人类核查结合起来,以确保几何有效性和问题清晰度。 自动过滤可以去除几何模糊的关系,标签接近决定边界,运动端点无效,视觉地面不足,以及由场景,视图,任务类型,和对象身份定义的近似复制. 在基准被冻结之前,在生成的集合中,答案位置是平衡的。 人类核查由10名注释员进行,每个问题都至少收到两次基于模式可见输入的独立审查;审查员检查了物体的可识别性、可视可回答性和问题清晰度,第三个审查员解决了分歧。 在判决前,单答问题达成了98.9%的对接协议,附件链问题达成了91.8%的精确设定协议. 见附录 B用于完整的任务定义、施工细节和质量控制程序。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate 21 models in 3 groups: 9 proprietary models, 6 general-purpose open-weight models, and 6 spatially specialized models. The proprietary set includes Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026b ) ; Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini 3 Flash ( Google, 2026 ; Google, 2025 ) ; GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2026a ) ; Doubao 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed Team, 2026 ) ; and Qwen3.6-Flash and Qwen3.7-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . The general-purpose open-weight set comprises InternVL3.5-8B ( InternVL Team, 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3.5 models at 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) . The spatially specialized set contains VST-7B-RL ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , SenseNova-SI-1.2 ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , Cambrian-S-7B ( Yang et al., 2025c ) , SpaceR ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , SpatialLadder ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Spatial-MLLM-v1.1 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . All models are evaluated with a chain-of-thought prompt and deterministic decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了3个组的21个模型:9个专有模型,6个通用开放重量模型,6个空间专用模型. 专有套装包括克洛德·索内特 4.6和克洛德·索内特 5. (Anthropic, 2026a; Anthropic, 2026b; 双子3.5 Flash和双子3 Flash (Google, 2026; Google, 2025)); GPT-5.4和GPT-5.6-Luna (OpenAI, 2026c; OpenAI, 2026a;); Doubao 2.0 Pro (ByteDance种子队, 2026;和Quen3.6-Flash和Quen3.7-Plus (Quen Team, 2026b.). 通用开放重量套装包括: InternVL3.5-8B (InternVL Team, 2025), Quen3-VL-4B (Bai等, 2025), 和 在 2B, 4B, 9B, 和 27B (Quen Team, 2026a) 的 Quen3.5 型号. 该空间专用集包含VST-7B-RL(杨等,2025b),SenseNova-SI-1.2(蔡等,2026),Cambrian-S-7B(杨等,2025c),SpaceR(欧阳等,2025b),SpaceLadder. (Li等,2026),和Space-MLLM-v1.1 (Wu等,2025.). 所有模型都通过一个思维链的即时和决定性的解码加以评估。

blocks.en: Our primary metric is the overall score, defined as the unweighted macro-average of per-task accuracy across all 16 task types. We additionally report Static, Local, and Global averages, each computed as the macro-average over the task types in the corresponding transformation family. See Appendix C for evaluation protocols, prompts, and more training details.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要衡量标准是总体得分,即所有16个任务类型中每个任务准确度的未加权宏观平均值。 此外,我们还报告静态、地方和全球平均值,每个均作为相应转型家族中任务类型的宏观平均值计算。 见附录 C用于评价协议、提示和更多的培训细节。

Bold indicates the best model result in each column; baselines are excluded.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports accuracy across all 16 task types. Human-level performance stands at 87.2%, providing an upper bound against which all models fall substantially short. Among proprietary models, Gemini 3.5 Flash leads at 58.0%, followed by Gemini 3 Flash (56.7%) and Qwen3.7-Plus (55.3%), with the remaining models ranging down to 36.0% (Claude Sonnet 4.6); even the best model trails human level by 29.2 pp, highlighting the substantial headroom that remains. The strongest general-purpose open-weight model, Qwen3.5-27B, reaches 39.3%, 18.7 pp below the top proprietary model and 47.9 pp below human level. Spatially specialized models score lowest overall (25.7–29.1%), falling below every proprietary and general-purpose open-weight model despite being explicitly trained for spatial tasks, and remain near the random baseline of 25.9%, suggesting that current spatial fine-tuning paradigms have yet to instill genuine spatial reasoning capabilities. See Appendix D for qualitative analysis and representative failure cases.
blocks.zh: 表1报告所有16个任务类别的准确性。 人类水平的绩效为87.2%,提供了一个上限,所有模型都大大低于这一上限。 在专有模型中,双子座3.5 Flash领先58.0%,其次是双子座3 Flash (56.7%)和Quen3.7-Plus (55.3%),其余模型从下至36.0%(Claude Sonnet 4.6);甚至最佳模型以29.2页的比分追平了人类水平,凸显出所剩有的实质性头部. 最强的通用开放重量型号为Quen3.5-27B,达到39.3%,最高专有型号下方为18.7pp,人文水平下方为47.9pp. 空间专业模型总体得分最低(25.7-29.1%),尽管在空间任务方面受到明确培训,但仍低于每个专有和通用的开放式模型,而且仍然接近25.9%的随机基线,这表明目前的空间微调范式尚未形成真正的空间推理能力。 见附录 D用于定性分析和代表性故障案例。

blocks.en: Predictive reasoning is broadly harder than static perception, though the pattern differs across model groups. Proprietary and general-purpose open-weight models both score lower on L2 than L1, with the largest drops for Gemini 3.5 Flash ( − 21.8 -21.8 pp), Qwen3.7-Plus ( − 20.6 -20.6 pp), and Qwen3.6-Flash ( − 18.3 -18.3 pp). Spatially specialized models show a slightly higher group average on L2 than L1, yet all three groups decline on L3 relative to L1. The strongest proprietary models recover substantially at L3 (Gemini 3.5 Flash: L2 45.3%, L3 69.4%; Qwen3.7-Plus: L2 43.2%, L3 66.6%), reflecting strong performance on global rotation tasks where a holistic grasp of spatial layout appears sufficient. Spatially specialized models instead show markedly lower L3 averages (e.g., SenseNova-SI-1.2: L2 30.5%, L3 16.1%; Cambrian-S-7B: L2 28.8%, L3 17.1%), suggesting that spatial fine-tuning reinforces local perceptual features while leaving global spatial awareness undeveloped. These opposing patterns point to fundamentally different capability profiles rather than a uniform scaling of spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 预测性推理比静态感知大致更难,尽管模型组的规律不同. 专有和通用的开口量模型在L2上的得分都比L1低,双子座3.5 Flash(-21.8-21.8页),Qune3.7-Plus(-20.6-20.6页)和Qune3.6-Flash(-18.3-18.3页)的得分最大. 空间专用模型显示L2的组平均比L1略高,而所有三个组都比L1下降. 最强的专有型号在L3(Gemini 3.5 Flash:L2 45.3%,L3 69.4%;Quen3.7-Plus:L2 43.2%,L3 66.6%)得到大幅回升,这反映了全球自转任务的强效性能,因为对于空间布局的整体把握似乎已经足够了. 相反,空间专用模型显示的L3平均值明显较低(例如:SenseNova-SI-1.2:L2 30.5%,L3 16.1%;Cambrian-S-7B:L2 28.8%,L3 17.1%),这表明空间微调加强了局部的知觉特征,同时使全球的空间意识没有得到发展。 这些对立的模式表明能力剖面存在根本的不同,而不是空间推理的统一尺度.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports accuracy per spatial relation category, averaged over all task types within each category across L1–L3. Attachment yields the highest scores across selected proprietary and open-weight models (Qwen3.7-Plus: 80.4%, GPT-5.6-Luna: 74.2%, Qwen3.5-27B: 68.0%), suggesting that binary contact judgements are comparatively tractable. Occlusion ranks second for most models, while direction and distance remain the most challenging relation types. Spatially specialized models score disproportionately low on attachment (SenseNova-SI-1.2: 13.4%, SpatialLadder: 9.3%), indicating that attachment relations are severely underrepresented in existing spatial fine-tuning data and task design.
blocks.zh: 表3按空间关系类别报告准确性,平均为L1-L3各类别内的所有任务类型。 附件在所选专有和开放量级模型中得分最高(Quen3.7-Plus:80.4%,GPT-5.6-Luna:74.2%,Quen3.5-27B:68.0%),说明二进制接触判断是相对可拉动的. 在大多数模型中,占据第二位,而方向和距离仍然是最具挑战性的关系类型。 空间专用模型在附件上的得分过低(SenseNova-SI-1.2:13.4%,SpaceLadder:9.3%),表明附件关系在现有空间微调数据和任务设计中的代表性严重不足.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports accuracy per directional reference frame, averaged over all direction-type tasks across L1–L3. World-centric reasoning is the strongest reference frame across both selected proprietary models (Qwen3.7-Plus: 58.4%, GPT-5.6-Luna: 49.9%), while camera-centric reasoning remains competitive for Qwen3.7-Plus (53.9%) and GPT-5.6-Luna (45.7%). Object-centric reasoning is consistently the weakest frame among proprietary and open-weight models, with Qwen3-VL-4B exhibiting the largest camera–object gap (39.3% vs. 16.2%). Spatially specialized models show no clear reference frame preference, with scores clustered in the 22–32% range, suggesting a general deficit rather than frame-specific weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 表3报告每个方向参考框架的准确性,平均为L1-L3的所有方向类任务。 以世界为中心的推理是两个选定的专有模型中最强的参考框架(Qune3.7-Plus:58.4%,GPT-5.6-Luna:49.9%),而以相机为中心的推理仍然对Qune3.7-Plus(53.9%)和GPT-5.6-Luna(45.7%)具有竞争力. 以物体为中心的推理始终是专有型和开放型模型中最弱的框架,而Qune3-VL-4B显示的相机-对象差距最大(39.3%对16.2%)。 空间专门模型没有显示明确的参考框架偏好,分数集中在22-32%的范围内,这表明总的缺陷而不是特定框架的弱点。

blocks.en: Key Takeaways: Predictive Spatial Reasoning Remains Challenging • All evaluated models remain far below human spatial reasoning. • General-purpose models outperform models explicitly fine-tuned for spatial tasks. • Strong static perception does not reliably translate into spatial state updating.
blocks.zh: 关键外出:预测空间原因仍然挑战性 所有评估模型都远远低于人类空间推理。 • 通用模型明显优于用于空间任务的精细模型。 • 强烈的静态感知不能可靠地转化为空间状态更新。

blocks.en: All evaluated models remain far below human spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 所有评估模型都远远低于人类空间推理。

blocks.en: General-purpose models outperform models explicitly fine-tuned for spatial tasks.
blocks.zh: 通用模型优于模型,明确对空间任务进行微调.

blocks.en: Strong static perception does not reliably translate into spatial state updating.
blocks.zh: 强烈的静态感知并不能可靠地转化为空间状态更新.

blocks.en: 4.3 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 进一步分析

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the accuracy gap between CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) and Direct prompting for six representative models, broken down by capability level. CoT does not provide a uniform advantage: its effect varies sharply across model families and capability levels. It improves global tasks for Qwen3.7-Plus but harms its static and local performance, whereas Qwen3-VL-4B shows the opposite pattern. The two spatially specialized models are similarly mixed, indicating that explicit rationales interact with a model’s existing spatial capability profile rather than reliably inducing predictive spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图6显示COT(Wei等人,2022年)和直接提示六个代表性模型的准确性差距,按能力级别分列. COT不提供统一的优势:它的效果在模范家庭和能力水平上差异很大. 它改进了Qwen3.7-Plus的全球任务,但损害了它的静态和局部性能,而Qwen3-VL-4B则显示出了相反的模式. 这两个空间专门模型同样混合,表明明确的理由与模型的现有空间能力剖面相互作用,而不是可靠地诱导预测空间推理。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the mean directional accuracy with and without bridge views across six representative models, averaged over three reference frames. Removing bridge views consistently lowers accuracy across all three reference frames. The largest drop occurs for world-centric direction ( 39.9 % 39.9\% to 34.6 % 34.6\% , − 5.3 -5.3 pp), while camera-centric ( − 1.9 -1.9 pp) and object-centric ( − 1.7 -1.7 pp) direction show smaller decreases. This pattern suggests that bridge views are particularly important for maintaining a scene-level spatial representation across views.
blocks.zh: 图6显示6个代表性模型的平均方向精确度,有的没有桥接,平均有三个参考框架。 清除桥接视图始终降低所有三个参考框架的准确性。 最大的下降发生在以世界为中心的方向(39.9% 39.9% 至 34.6% 34.6% ; - 5.3 - 5.3pp),而以相机为中心的方向(− 1.9 - 1.9pp)和以物体为中心的方向(− 1.7 - 1.7pp)则显示较小的下降。 这种模式表明,桥梁观点对于保持场景层面的跨观点空间代表性特别重要。

blocks.en: Recent work suggests that generative world models can support spatial reasoning by providing imagined observations of future scene states ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . Motivated by this, we test whether external evidence can alleviate different bottlenecks in our observe–transform–infer pipeline, using the same six representative models as in Figure 6 . We consider two evidence families: explicit 3D evidence augments S 0 S_{0} with a BEV image or textual 3D metadata, while world-model evidence approximates S 1 S_{1} via post-intervention images from Qwen-Image-Edit ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) or GPT-image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , or a transformation video from Seedance2-mini ( ByteDance, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,基因世界模型可以通过提供对未来场景状态的想象观测支持空间推理(张等,2026;杨等,2026b;曹等,2026. 因此,我们用图6中相同的六个代表性模式来检验外部证据是否能够缓解我们观察-变换-推断管道中的各种瓶颈。 我们认为有两个证据家族:明确的3D证据用BEV图像或文字3D元数据来增强S0 S_{0},而世界模型证据则通过从Quen-Image-Edit(Quen Team, 2025年)或GPT-image-2(OpenAI, 2026年b)的干涉后图像,或从Seedance2-mini(ByteDance, 2026年)的变相视频.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows that general-purpose models effectively exploit explicit 3D evidence. Both proprietary and open-weight models improve with BEV images, and textual 3D metadata yields substantially larger gains (+30.7 pp and +10.9 pp, respectively). The stronger response among proprietary models suggests that recovering 3D structure from visual observations is a primary bottleneck: once made explicit, these models can perform the subsequent transformation and relational reasoning. Spatially specialized models show little benefit and decline with 3D metadata ( − 3.3 -3.3 pp), suggesting that fine-tuning without such evidence reduces their ability to exploit unfamiliar spatial representations.
blocks.zh: 图7显示,通用模型有效地利用了明确的立体证据。 专有和开放式模型都随着BEV图像的改进而得到改进,文字3D元数据产生的收益大为增加(分别为+30.7页和+10.9页)。 专有模型之间的更强烈反应表明从视觉观测中恢复出3D结构是一个主要的瓶颈:这些模型一旦明确化,就可以进行后续的转化和关系推理. 空间专用模型与3D元数据(-3.3-3.3页)相比没有什么好处和下降,这表明没有这种证据的微调会削弱它们利用不熟悉的空间表示的能力。

blocks.en: World-model evidence produces much smaller and less consistent changes. To determine whether this reflects generation failures or ineffective evidence use, we manually audit generated endpoints for 600 local-intervention questions. Among incorrect responses across 6 representative models, 80.3% under Qwen-Image-Edit and 38.3% under GPT-image-2 are associated with generation failures, including artifacts, missing objects, deformation, and scale or perspective mismatch. Errors that persist after successful generation reveal a second bottleneck: even given an approximate S 1 S_{1} , models must still align the synthesized endpoint with the original multi-view evidence. Closing this gap thus requires advances on both generation fidelity and cross-view evidence integration.
blocks.zh: 世界示范证据产生的变化较小,也不太一致。 为了确定这是否反映了生成失败或无效的证据使用,我们人工审计产生了600个当地干预问题的终点。 在6个代表性模型的不正确反应中,80.3%的Qwen-Image-Edit和38.3%的GPT-image-2与生成失败有关,包括文物,缺失的物品,变形,以及尺度或视角不匹配等. 在成功一代之后持续存在的错误揭示出第二个瓶颈:即使考虑到大约S 1 SQQ1},模型仍然必须使被合成的终点与原始多视图证据一致. 因此,要缩小这一差距,就需要在世代忠诚和交叉观点证据整合方面取得进展。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Effect of external spatial evidence. blocks.en: Table 4 shows that both SFT variants substantially improve predictive spatial reasoning on SpaceCast-Bench, with Mixed SFT reaching 64.8% and Staged SFT reaching 65.7% overall. Staged SFT improves Local performance from 51.3% to 54.0%, suggesting that progressively introducing higher-level task families benefits local state updating, while Mixed SFT is slightly stronger on Global tasks (73.1% vs. 70.8%). blocks.en: As Table 4 shows, both SFT variants transfer beyond SpaceCast-Bench across six OOD benchmarks ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Mirzaee et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2020 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) spanning multi-image and language-grounded spatial reasoning, limited-view mental modeling, physical event understanding, and dynamic video-based spatial reasoning. Staged SFT achieves the strongest macro average (38.1%), exceeding Mixed SFT (37.2%) and the base model (33.5%), with the largest gains on DSI-Bench (+10.2 pp), SPARTQA (+6.0 pp), CLEVRER (+5.8 pp), and VSI-Bench (+4.7 pp), while MindCube remains slightly below the base model. GRPO shows a distinct transfer profile, with substantial gains on MindCube and DSI-Bench, smaller improvements on VSI-Bench and MMSI, and slight declines on SPARTQA and CLEVRER. Despite their different transfer profiles, both SFT and GRPO improve the out-of-domain macro average over the base model, demonstrating that training on SpaceCast-Bench data yields transferable spatial reasoning gains regardless of the post-training paradigm.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate predictive spatial reasoning, where tasks progress from understanding observed scenes to updating spatial states and inferring relations in unobserved outcomes. Experiments reveal a substantial human–model gap and show that existing spatial training does not transfer to spatial state updating. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data yields consistent gains both in-domain and across six out-of-domain benchmarks, suggesting that predictive spatial reasoning represents a distinct and largely unsolved capability that SpaceCast-Bench is positioned to drive progress on.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SpaceCast-Bench,这是直接和诊断性地评估预测空间推理的第一个基准,其中的任务从了解所观测到的场景到更新空间状态以及推断在未观察到的结果中的关系。 实验揭示出一个巨大的人类模型差距并表明现有的空间培训不会转移到空间状态更新上. 对我们方案生成的数据进行精细调整,在域内和六个域外基准之间产生一致的收益,这表明预测空间推理是SpaceCast-Bench所定位的推动进展的独特和基本未解的能力。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: SpaceCast-Bench comprises 3,862 questions drawn from 182 ScanNet and ScanNet++ scenes, all of which are indoor environments; ScanNet++ alone contributes 3,144 questions. Consequently, the benchmark does not cover outdoor settings or object arrangements and scales absent from these two sources. Question labels depend on reconstructed meshes, depth maps, camera poses, and instance-level semantic annotations, so geometric errors can affect ray-cast visibility, apparent surface contact or support relationships, and whether a queried object is sufficiently recognizable in a selected view. We exclude geometrically ambiguous cases and require independent review by at least two annotators per question, though these measures cannot fully eliminate reconstruction-related uncertainty in occlusion and attachment labels, particularly for objects with incomplete geometry or low reconstruction confidence. Finally, the three intervention types (translations, rotations, and removals) update scene geometry programmatically without simulating physical dynamics, so the benchmark does not assess deformation, friction, or collision-driven motion effects.

blocks.en: Direction is computed from the relative vector between object centers. Its floor-plane projection is quantized into eight 45-degree sectors, while a separate vertical rule assigns above or below . Pairs near a directional decision boundary are excluded.

blocks.en: Distance approximates the shortest surface-to-surface separation between two instances using sampled mesh points with local triangle refinement. When surface samples are unavailable, the fallback uses the closest points on their 3D bounding boxes. The result is mapped to four categories: very close ( < 1.0 <1.0 m), close ( 1.0 1.0 – 2.0 2.0 m), moderate ( 2.0 2.0 – 3.3 3.3 m), and far ( > 3.3 >3.3 m). Questions within 0.1 m of a category boundary are excluded.
blocks.zh: 距离大约是使用局部三角化精细化的取样网点在两个实例之间最短的地对地分离。 当表面样品无法取出时,倒回式会使用其3D边框上最接近的点. 该结果被映射为四类:非常接近( < 1.0 < 1.0 m),接近(1.0 1.0–2.0 2.0 m),中度(2.0 2.0–3.3 3.3 m)和远相( >3.3 > 3.3 m). 类别边界0.1米以内的问题不在此列。

blocks.en: The relation engine samples points on a target mesh, projects them into the calibrated camera, and ray casts each sample against the reconstructed scene mesh. A sample is considered visible when the target is the first valid intersection at the expected distance; a closer non-target intersection indicates external occlusion. Aggregated ray outcomes and camera-facing probes together distinguish three states: not occluded, occluded, and not visible. Removal questions recompute visibility after the specified deletion, while movement questions compute directed pairwise occlusion between the queried objects.
blocks.zh: 关联引擎样本将指向目标网格,将其投放到校正相机中,而射线将每个样本投放在被重建的场景网格上. 当目标为预期距离上的第一个有效相接点时,一个样本被认为是可见的;一个更接近的非目标相接点表示外部被隔离. 综合射线结果和相机相机相机探测器一起区分出三个状态:不被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被被所所所所看不到. 删除问题在指定删除后重新计算能见度,而移动问题则计算被询问对象之间的定向对偶隔离。

blocks.en: The generator constructs a directed attachment graph from 3D contact, horizontal support overlap or containment, and semantic compatibility. Every child has at most one parent, and cycle-forming edges are rejected. The transitive descendants of a moved root define the component that moves with it; attachment-chain questions require exact-set identification of these descendants.
blocks.zh: 生成器从3D接头构造出一个定向附件图,水平支持重叠或封接,以及语义相容. 每个孩子最多有一个父母,而周期形成边缘则被拒绝。 一个被移动的根的过渡性后人定义了随它移动的成分;附件链问题需要对这些后人进行精确的设定识别.

blocks.en: L1 evaluates relations in the unmodified scene. For L2, object translations displace a selected root and its attachment descendants in the specified movement frame; object rotations move the component along a horizontal orbit of 45, 90, 135, or 180 degrees around a static pivot while preserving the moved object’s intrinsic facing direction. Removal applies the specified deletion before visibility is recomputed. For L3, global transformations rotate the complete layout by 90, 180, or 270 degrees while keeping the designated camera fixed. The relation engine is rerun on the resulting 3D state to obtain the programmatic label. Candidates that would leave the estimated room bounds or introduce a new strict 3D bounding-box collision are rejected.
blocks.zh: L1在未经修改的场景中评价关系. 对于 L2 , 对象翻译在指定的运动框中取代了所选择的根及其附件的后继;对象自转将部件沿着一个平向轨道移动,这个平向轨道为 45, 90, 135, 或180度, 围绕一个静态中枢, 同时保留被移动对象的内在正向方向. 删除在重算可见度之前应用指定的删除. 对于L3,全局变换在保持指定相机固定的同时以90,180或270度旋转完整的布局. 关系引擎在结果的3D状态上重新运行,以获得程序标签. 将离开估计房间界限或引入新的严格3D界限-框相撞的候选者被拒绝。

blocks.en: Question templates instantiate the transformation, object roles, requested reference frame, and answer candidates. Template variants for L1, L2, and L3 are shown in Tables 6 – 8 . Direction and distance tasks use four answer choices. Horizontal direction candidates are spaced at 90-degree intervals on the eight-direction ring so that adjacent directional labels do not serve as ambiguous distractors. Occlusion tasks use three choices, while attachment-chain questions are four-option multiple-selection items scored by exact set match. Semantic ground truth is computed before option order is randomized, and answer positions are balanced across the generated pool.

blocks.en: B.6 Quality Control
blocks.zh: B.6 质量控制

blocks.en: Automatic filtering removes geometrically ambiguous relations, distance labels near category boundaries, invalid motion endpoints, insufficiently grounded objects, and near-duplicate questions. Because finite 3D reconstruction accuracy is especially consequential for occlusion, attachment, and referability, these properties also undergo human verification. Ten annotators reviewed the benchmark; every question was independently assessed by at least two annotators who were blind to each other’s decisions and to the programmatic answer. Disagreements were referred to a third annotator, who first made a blind judgment from the model-visible input and could consult geometry and generation traces only afterward.
blocks.zh: 自动过滤可以去除几何模糊的关系,距离标签接近类别边界,运动端点无效,没有足够被禁用的对象,以及近似重复的问题. 由于有限的三维重建精度对被隔离、附着和可参照性特别有影响,这些属性也经过了人类的验证。 10名注释员审查了基准;每个问题都由至少两名注释员独立评估,他们对彼此的决定和方案答案视而不见。 分歧被提交给了第三个注释者,他首先从模型可见的输入中做出盲目判断,并且只能在后期查阅几何和生成痕迹.

blocks.en: Prior to adjudication, the 3,801 single-answer questions received 7,602 initial ratings with 98.9% pairwise answer agreement. Reviewers disagreed on the answer for 42 questions and on answerability for a further 42 questions; the two categories overlapped on 15 questions, yielding 69 unique questions sent to third-review adjudication. For the 97 attachment-chain questions, reviewers achieved 91.8% exact-set agreement. The complete quality-control process produced 157 ground-truth corrections, 143 question or option rewrites, and 36 removals, with 38 questions receiving both a ground-truth correction and a rewrite. All rewritten questions were independently reviewed by two annotators before inclusion.
blocks.zh: 在判决前,3,801个单接答题获得了7,602个初始收视率,98.9%的对接答协议. 审查者对42个问题的答案和另外42个问题的答案有分歧;这两类问题在15个问题上重叠,产生了69个独特的问题,送交第三次审查裁决。 关于97个附件链问题,审查人员达成了91.8%的精确设定协议。 完整的质量控制程序产生了157个地真相校正、143个问题或选项重写和36个去除,38个问题既收到地真相校正,也收到重写。 所有重写的问题在列入之前都由两位注释员独立审查.

blocks.en: C.1 Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: C.1 评价规程和计量

blocks.en: The primary SpaceCast-Bench evaluation uses a standardized chain-of-thought (CoT) prompt with deterministic decoding. The CoT condition requests brief reasoning followed by the final option on the last line; the Direct condition requests only the final option. Single-choice questions are scored by the selected option, and attachment-chain questions require an exact match to the canonical option set. Paired diagnostics compare identical question identifiers under different prompting or evidence conditions.
blocks.zh: 初级SpaceCast-Bench评价采用标准化的思维链(COT)快取,具有决定性的解码. CoT条件要求简短推理,最后在最后一行选择;直接条件只要求最后选择. 单选题由所选选项打出分数,附件链题则需要精确地匹配克能选项集. 在不同的提示或证据条件下,Paired诊断比较了相同的问题识别符.

blocks.en: The primary Overall score is the macro-average of the 16 task-type accuracies, with each task type weighted equally. Static, Local, and Global scores average the task-type accuracies within each capability level; relation-type and reference-frame summaries are computed analogously.

blocks.en: C.2 Human and Random Baselines
blocks.zh: C.2 人类基线和随机基线

blocks.en: Twelve volunteers answered the benchmark using only the model-visible views and answer options, without additional guidance. This evaluation was conducted independently from the ten-annotator quality-control review. Their type-macro accuracy was 87.2%, with 3,340 correct answers out of 3,862 questions. For the random baseline, we use seed 42 to sample uniformly from the displayed options for single-choice questions and from the eight valid answer sets for attachment-chain questions.

blocks.en: Figures 11 – 14 present representative failure cases that reveal two intertwined limitations. The first is imperfect spatial perception: models construct only a shallow scene representation from the input views, anchoring on salient foreground objects or image-space cues rather than recovering consistent 3D structure. Depth ordering, ground-plane relations, and inter-object distances are frequently misestimated, and local observations across views are rarely integrated into a coherent whole. The second limitation is brittle transformation reasoning: even when the relevant objects are correctly located, models struggle to propagate an intervention through the scene. Movement direction is conflated with the resulting spatial relation, rigidly attached objects are left behind, and the post-intervention state is evaluated in the wrong reference frame or derived by a shallow 2D heuristic rather than genuine 3D recomputation. Removal questions expose a further failure mode in which visibility is only partially updated: models treat the deleted object as the sole occluder and equate a still-visible target with an unoccluded one. Taken together, these cases suggest that current vision-language models lack a persistent, manipulable scene representation, one that can be queried from an arbitrary viewpoint and updated under programmatic interventions, and that closing this gap is a prerequisite for reliable spatial reasoning in dynamic environments.
blocks.zh: 图11至图14列出了两个相互交织的缺陷。 第一种是不完善的空间感知:模型仅从输入视图中构建出浅浅的场景表现,以突出的前地物体或图像-空间提示为锚地,而不是恢复一致的三维结构. 深度订购,地上平面关系,和物体间距离经常被误估出,各地对观点的观察也很少融入一个连贯的整体. 第二个限制是Brittle Transform explain:即使相关对象被正确定位,模型也难以将干预传播到现场. 运动方向与所形成的空间关系相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 移除问题暴露出另一个故障模式,在这种模式中,能见度仅得到部分更新:模型将被删除的物体视为唯一占地者,并将仍可被忽略的目标等同于未被忽略的目标. 总之,这些案例表明,目前的视觉语言模式缺乏持续、可操作的场景表现,这种表现可以从任意的角度提出,并在方案干预下加以更新,缩小这一差距是在动态环境中可靠的空间推理的先决条件。

Correct answers are shown in green; erroneous reasoning and predictions are highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 图11:L1相机方向. 模型与其恢复地平板布局并在第一主要视图相机框中表达出来,不如采用图像空间左-右位置或锁定在上一个输入视图上. 正确的答案用绿色显示;错误的推理和预测用红色突出显示.

blocks.en: Figure 12: L2 Remove Occlusion. Models treat the removed tap as the sole occluder and conclude that the hand-soap bottle is now fully visible, failing to recompute visibility against the complete remaining scene. The case illustrates a broader pattern in which partial visibility is equated with the absence of occlusion. Correct answers are shown in green; erroneous reasoning and predictions are highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 图12:L2 消除隐患。 模型将被取走的自来水龙头作为唯一的接地器,并得出结论,手肥皂瓶现在已完全可见了,未能将能见度与完整的所剩场景相相重算. 该案表明一种更广泛的模式,即部分可见度等同于没有隔离。 正确的答案用绿色显示;错误的推理和预测用红色突出显示.

blocks.en: Figure 13: L2 Move World Direction. Models conflate the table’s movement direction with the resulting direction of the mouse relative to the bottle, or substitute coarse room semantics for the required world-coordinate relation. The case further requires propagating the table’s displacement to its rigidly attached mouse, an attachment dependency that models consistently overlook. Correct answers are shown in green; erroneous reasoning and predictions are highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 图13:L2移动世界方向. 模型将表格的移动方向与鼠标相对于瓶子产生的方向相混淆,或者用粗室语义来替代所需的世界坐标关系. 该案例还要求将表格的置换到其紧附的鼠标上,这是模型一贯忽略的附着依赖。 正确的答案用绿色显示;错误的推理和预测用红色突出显示.

blocks.en: Figure 14: L3 Rotate Camera Direction. Models apply a superficial left–right reversal or reason from an unreformed input view rather than rotating the full scene layout and recomputing the queried relation in the fixed camera frame. The case illustrates how transformation reasoning degrades when it requires maintaining and manipulating a global scene representation. Correct answers are shown in green; erroneous reasoning and predictions are highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 图14:L3旋转相机方向. 模型从未修改的输入视图中应用了表面的左-右倒转或理由,而不是旋转整个场景布局并重算固定相机框中被询问的关系. 该案说明,当转型推理需要维持和操纵全球场景时,它是如何退化的。 正确的答案用绿色显示;错误的推理和预测用红色突出显示.
